# Europe Journal, 1966









Source file: `vol2.pdf`. This is a separate document from the WWII journals and is processed in its own run. Pages 1 to 6 are front matter (a three-page table of contents, an itinerary and a mail schedule); entries begin on page 7 with the entry for Friday, 24 June 1966. The text includes German, French and Dutch names.
